Indexing gathers your photos, stacks photos together that are the same, and uses machine learning to determine the contents of the photos without using the Internet or uploading your photos anywhere. sortandpost.photos is built with privacy in mind

sortandpost.photos uses a slow indexing speed to run in the background without causing delays on your computer. The slow setting uses {slow_w} cpu core(s). If you have a large quantity of photos you'd like to index quickly, turn on fast indexing. It will slow down your computer, but index photos much faster.
Fast uses all CPU cores and may slow down your computer.

sortandpost.photos downloads a machine learning model that automatically categorizes photos. i.e. sunset, dog on beach, portrait. This is a 600MB model that runs locally. Your photos are never sent to the cloud or on anyone else's computer
